name: austendewolf
description: Austen DeWolf's public Claude Code plugins: the daybook that reads a handwritten page, and the renderer that turns HTML into a PNG or PDF.

plugins.name: daybook
plugins.description: Turn a photographed page of handwritten notes into a daily list of actions, capped at three for today.

plugins.name: render-visual
plugins.description: Render a table, matrix, org chart or comparison grid from HTML to a trimmed PNG or a landscape PDF with headless Chrome.
